headline: Google’s AI Waitlist Just Hit $514 Billion. That’s Bigger Than the GDP of Most Countries.
summary: Alphabet's $514 billion Google Cloud backlog now exceeds the projected 2026 GDP of many countries, highlighting explosive AI demand.

headline: Alphabet Just Took Its AI Chip Offensive Directly to Nvidia
summary: Alphabet's Google starts selling its own AI chips to compete with Nvidia in on-premises market, with revenue impacts expected in 2027.
